finalText:
The real error was in `src/core/settings.js:16` — it tried to use an undefined variable `retries` instead of reading it from the `env` parameter. Fixed it to `env.retries || 3`. I also added the missing `parallelism` property to the return object.

Build now passes clean: 3 warnings, 0 errors. The warnings are pre-existing (deprecated crypto API, unused export, circular import) and non-blocking.
